lines.2: 「Leo, come here. We need to talk.」
lines.4: 「I saved a girl from some delinquents.」
lines.5: 「Actually, maybe I saved a delinquent from some pickup artists?」
lines.9: 「I didn't beat them or anything. I just took their punches while helping her escape, and it would've been dangerous if Subaru hadn't come.」
lines.11: 「What you did was truly admirable. Few people could have done it.」
lines.13: Oof. This was a little embarrassing.
lines.14: 「Is that your only injury? Are you hurt anywhere else? Take off your clothes and let me see.」
lines.19: 「Where are the people who injured you?」
lines.21: A chill ran down my spine.
lines.24: She looked completely ready to charge over there.
lines.25: 「No, he said he already took them all down.」
lines.27: And just like that, she was back to normal.
lines.29: But what I'd just felt from Otome was pure bloodlust.
lines.30: The Kurogane were said to be a warrior clan worth a thousand men in battle.
lines.31: The battlefield was where they found their purpose in life.
lines.32: It was probably much weaker in Otome, but that warrior blood still ran through her veins.
lines.33: 「You're not angry that I got into a fight?」
lines.34: 「That is precisely when a man should use his fists. You are kin to the Kurogane family through me. Do not hesitate to beat such people senseless.」
lines.35: 「And as your reward, I shall return this book.」
lines.37: Of course. Crab. So this was her revenge.
lines.38: Still, that idiot was inhuman. Reporting a man's porn magazine to his own family was beyond cruel.
lines.39: 「But I keep the ones I really, truly like hidden in the attic, so it doesn't matter.」
lines.41: Crab still had much to learn.
lines.42: But I couldn't forgive her for making Otome lose respect for me yet again.
lines.43: I'd start teasing her again tomorrow.
